sections.heading: Boiling water
sections.body: TEST FIXTURE. Bring water to a rolling boil before drinking it.

sections.heading: Storing water
sections.body: TEST FIXTURE. Keep stored water in clean sealed containers away from sunlight.

sections.heading: Building a campfire
sections.body: TEST FIXTURE. Gather tinder, kindling and fuel wood before lighting a fire.

sections.heading: Putting out a fire
sections.body: TEST FIXTURE. Drown the fire with water and stir the ashes until cold.
